definitions.explanation: Going across something, especially a road or street.
Traveling across a large area like a continent.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (horizontal/sideways) + ⟦{断|だん}→断：noentry⟧ (cut across). Means crossing from one side to another, especially roads or large areas.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横断|おうだん}する

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横断|おうだん}⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧: crosswalk, pedestrian crossing
- {横断|おうだん}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no crossing (road sign)
- ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横断|おうだん}する: to cross the road

COMMON COMPOUNDS (TRAVERSAL):
- ⟦{大陸|たいりく}→大陸：03400_tairiku⟧{横断|おうだん}: transcontinental crossing
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{横断|おうだん}: crossing Japan
- ⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧{横断|おうだん}⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: cross-country trip across America
- ⟦シベリア→シベリア：noentry⟧{横断|おうだん}⟦{鉄道|てつどう}→鉄道：03550_tetsudou⟧: Trans-Siberian Railway

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {横断|おうだん}: crossing (side to side, horizontally)
- ⟦{縦断|じゅうだん}→縦断：09035_juudan⟧: traversing (top to bottom, lengthwise)

USAGE:
In everyday life, {横断|おうだん}⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧ (crosswalk) is the most commonly encountered compound.
